sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
REFORMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS REFORMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the
North‑West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Act,
1999
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary. 5th July, 2001]
No. Legis.
1(3)99‑3395, dated 3‑7‑2001.‑‑The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
North‑West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5 of N.-W.F.P. Act XII of 1999

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
REFORMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MEDICAL AND HEALTH
INSTITUTIONS REFORMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the
North‑West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Act,
1999
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary. 5th July, 2001]
No. Legis.
1(3)99‑3395, dated 3‑7‑2001.‑‑The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment
of section 5 of N.‑W.F.P. Act XII of 1999.‑‑In the North‑West
Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Act, 1999 (N.‑W.F.P.
Act XII of 1999), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 5 the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"5. Administration.‑‑(1)
The Administration and management of the affairs of a medical institution shall, subject to the general supervision and
control of Government, vest in
the Management Committee appointed in accordance with the provisions of section 6 of this Act.
(2) The
administration and management of the affairs of a health institution shall,
subject to general supervision and control of Government, vest in the Hospital
Management Committee appointed in accordance with the provisions of section 6A
of this Act.

An Ordinance to amend the
North‑West Frontier Province Medical and Health Institutions Reforms Act,
1999
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary. 5th July, 2001]
No. Legis.
1(3)99‑3395, dated 3‑7‑2001.‑‑The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
3. Insertion
of section 6A to N.‑W.F.P. Act XII of 1999.‑‑In the said
Act, after section 6, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"6A. Hospital
Management Committee.‑‑(1) There shall be a Hospital Management Committee to administer and manage
the affairs of a health institution
which shall consist of‑‑‑
(i) District Coordinator
Officer
Chairman
(ii) District Health Officer
concerned
Member
(iii) Medical Superintendent
Member‑cum‑Secretary
(iv) Not less than two and not
more than three non‑official members from renowned social workers to be
nominated by the District Government concerned.
Members
(v) A Representative of
Government
Member
(2) A non‑official
member shall, unless otherwise directed by Government, hold office for a period
of three years and shall be eligible for re‑appointment.
(3) The Medical
Superintendent shall also act as Secretary to the Hospital Management
Committee.
